note: WP-I5 route → family map for the v11.6.0 One Door OpenAPI contract pipeline.
Every operation in the committed frontend/openapi.json is listed exactly once,
keyed 'METHOD /path' with the path template as the schema spells it.
'family' is derived: module_family[module], unless the operation appears in
'overrides' (worker-box routes and SPA page shells cut across their module).
tests/unit/test_openapi_composition.py enforces both the bijection with the
committed spec and that derivation rule, so an edit here cannot drift.
Family names are the v11.6.0 work-package names; 'worker_keep' is the surface
that stays in the Python AI worker and is the gateway's proxy allowlist.
'greedy_path_params' records the FastAPI '{name:path}' converters the schema
cannot show: those segments match slashes, so an axum port needs a wildcard
('/*name' in axum 0.7) rather than a plain ':name' capture.
v11.8.0 deleted eight caller-less worker routes end-to-end; their entries
left this map, the committed spec and every fragment together.

source.module_attribution: FastAPI route.endpoint.__module__ of the app built by scripts/export_openapi.py

auth.summary: Login, register, session, account and SSO endpoints.

static_ui.summary: Static assets, SPA shells and the host status/sysinfo surface served straight from the gateway.

ui_redirects.summary: Legacy HTML page routes that only render or redirect to an SPA shell, living in feature modules today.

workspace.summary: Workspace OS and org surface plus scope, invitations and the permission approval queue.

admin.summary: Admin console, security dashboard, feature toggles, funnel metrics and the setup wizard.

chat.summary: Chat orchestration, chat history and the agent-loop HTTP surface.

memory_brain.summary: Memory manager, brain intelligence, garden, chronicle, command center and evidence actions.

knowledge_search.summary: Knowledge graph, search, index jobs, local files, local knowledge roots and browser capture.

review_proposals.summary: Review queue, change proposals, automation intelligence and the hooks registry.

mcp_market.summary: MCP, marketplace, plugin SDK, agent registry, multi-agent runtime and the direct tool surface.

portability_network.summary: Portability/backup/share, peer network, network boundary, realtime, project sessions and computer use.

models_misc.summary: Model catalog/recommendation reads, engine install surface, permission mode, workflow designer and the residual runtime probes.

worker_keep.summary: The surface whose handler stays inside the Python worker's interpreter: scout_routes.md's KEEP_WORKER set and the graph single-writer seam, less the eight caller-less routes v11.8.0 deleted end-to-end (embeddings providers, the two document-tool reads, the multimodal and voice-status probes, model switch/unload-all and engine pull-model).
